absent: Full signature and early steps of the swap activation routine whose tail is shown.
Layout of swap device descriptor, extent list, and cluster information.
Behavior of discard, enable, drain, poll, and file helpers invoked during activation.
Complete huge-page and upper-level page-table walk continuation beyond the truncated helper.
Core shrink, isolation, and slab shrinker registration logic behind reclaim invocations.
Sizing and layout of generation state, filters, and per-node walk batches.
Migration target allocation, memory-group iteration, and congestion interfaces.

findings.text: Activation tail records a default priority unless a prefer request supplies one, stores ordering keys as negations of that priority, marks solid state versus rotating media, and derives discard capabilities from device support with once versus pages variants selecting area or page behavior.

Swap bring-up proceeds through optional area discard, compressed store registration, swap file marking with write draining, then exposure; failures unwind in reverse with store deregistration, extent and cluster release, flag clearing, rotation accounting correction, and file release.

Activation serializes priority assignment and exposure with a dedicated mutex, clears usage flags under global spin protection, and holds inode protection across registration and draining with paired unlocks on all exits.
Area discard errors are reported but do not abort bring-up, while compressed store or drain failures abort before exposure, and cleanup nulls released cluster state before reuse.

Compressed swap registration sizes a per-type table array from total pages over per-address-space capacity, initializes each table, publishes count and pointer for the type, and reports allocation failure without publishing.

Swap status reporting counts pages from usable devices via a global atomic plus an estimate for devices marked used but not yet writable, and publishes free and total values derived from the same estimate.
Status reporting holds global swap protection while iterating device slots and reading per-device usage and totals.
Direct duplication resolves the owning device from an entry, validates presence and prior occupancy, then duplicates a single slot within its cluster and returns that outcome.
Missing owner triggers a one-time warning plus rate-limited diagnostic and an invalid argument result.

Usability is defined by nonemptiness of the active ordering, and throttling is skipped without input-output allowance, without usable swap, without congestion, or when the caller already throttles, otherwise the first block-backed available device is asked to throttle.
Throttle scanning uses availability protection only after cheap checks pass, avoiding global ordering contention when already throttled.

Boot initialization caches the architecture maximum swap size, creates a typesafe reclaimable table cache when tables are not page sized, and enables migration address support only when the maximum exceeds a bit-derived threshold.

Reclaim control carries target counts and masks, memory group targeting, anonymous versus file cost inputs, optional swappiness override, packed deactivation and permission bits, low-memory and mode bits, allocation order and scan aggressiveness levels, allocation mask, progress counters, nested stall counters, and persistent slab reclaim state.
Deactivation selectors use value 1 for anonymous and value 2 for file.
Default swappiness is 60.
Bloom filter shift is 15.

Item keys derive from a pointer hash split into low and high portions sized by twice the shift, testing requires both bits when a filter exists and passes vacuously otherwise, and updating sets any missing bits only when a filter exists.
Feedback position holds refaulted and total counts plus a signed gain used by scanning balance logic.
Pageout outcomes distinguish keeping a locked folio, activating a locked folio, successful unlock after dispatch, and clean locked state.
Folio reference assessment distinguishes reclaim, keep, and activate decisions.
Scan balancing distinguishes equal, fractional, anonymous-only, and file-only strategies.
Slab dropping iterates all memory groups per node accumulating freed memory, repeats across online nodes with geometrically increasing termination threshold, and aborts promptly on fatal signals.
Writeback accounting bumps a throttled counter and wakes the writeback throttle queue once observed progress beyond start exceeds a cluster-scaled allowance.
Mapping removal returns the folio size on successful detachment with reference release folded into unfreezing, and zero when detachment does not occur.
Demotion allocation first attempts the requested target node with node-local constraint and cleared mask, falling back to the broader caller control only if that attempt fails.

List reclaim groups consecutive same-node folios after clearing active state, reclaims each node group with writing unmapping and swapping allowed but demotion disabled, returns leftovers to least-recently-used handling, and suppresses nested reclaim during the operation.

Generation update leaves isolated folios untouched, marks first-touch non-executable file state as referenced without promotion, otherwise atomically installs the next generation with workingset indication and reports the prior generation.
Out-of-range generation input triggers a debug warning, and concurrent isolation is detected via missing generation bits with a negative return.

Batch accounting moves page counts between old and new generation buckets keyed by file versus anonymous and zone, while scan suitability requires young density averaging at least one per cache line over a clamped sampling factor.

Virtual area scanning excludes inaccessible, huge-table, non-recency, locked or special, and gate areas, excludes anonymous and shared-memory areas without swappiness, excludes unevictable or overswappiness file areas, and requires a read folio operation.

Leaf entry helpers accept only present non-zero entries with youth or notifier interest, validated frames confined to the scanning node, and folio helpers further require generation membership, node match, and group match checked under read-side protection.
Area iteration aligns the resume address up, bounds the scan window by mask, skips excluded areas, and clamps the result to the overlap of window and area.

Leaf range walking maps without initial locking, proceeds only on successful try-lock with stability recheck, enables batched table updates during iteration, and releases mapping with unlock; contention either retries later or skips without blocking.

Leaf walking counts total and young entries with per-walk statistics, batches contiguous large folio mappings, clears youth with notification, propagates dirtiness to the folio except for uncached swap-backed anonymous, and continues across adjacent areas within the window.
Log prefixing prepends module name to format strings.
Tracing support is enabled by defining creation macro in this translation unit.
Least-recently-used mode switch defaults to disabled false state.
Nonleaf youth clearing requires both architecture support and a capability gate.
Type selection treats zero swappiness as minimum and values below anonymous-only threshold as maximum.
Locked huge-page range walking resolves caller memory group and node context and derives generation from maximum sequence before scanning.
The listed swap status, duplication, throttling, slab dropping, writeback accounting, mapping removal, and page reclaim helpers are non-static and callable across the reclaim and swap subsystems.
